description:
Hi! I'm Yusuf, a student at WE Applied Technology Schools with a strong interest in AI, data analysis, networking, cybersecurity, and space exploration.
I enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and turning creative ideas into practical projects. I'm currently working on LunarLens, an AI-assisted platform that aims to make lunar surface data easier to explore and understand.
I'm looking for motivated teammates.I believe different skills and perspectives can make our project stronger.
